name: finish-reason-retry
summary: Makes pi's built-in auto-retry recognize 'Provider finish_reason: error' (raw OpenAI-completions providers, e.g. OpenRouter, completing a response with an unrecognized/error finish_reason) as a transient error, so it gets the same backoff-retry-then-reset handling as a 500 or rate limit instead of surfacing as a hard failure that needs a manual 'continue'.
